title: fix(objectql)!: every reader of the registry's overlay slot binds a row of an App's customization pair by the exact read's owner rule (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgFsy73HZkvJ2oZhcuoPr5Kt)_
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbGpwJzMFhChu9a91Q

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：App 的定制包（`<app>.custom`）里存的一行，注册表的其余读者（持有者集合、bundle 成员、按包读取、环境项）现在和精确读（`?package=`）用同一条归属规则判它归谁。
- 规则：行声明了 `overrides.package` 且 pair 定制该持有者 → 只归它；没声明时 App 自己持有 → 归 App（#28390 裁决 A）；只有一个 App 内的包持有 → 归它；两个以上 → 谁也不归。持有者按精确读的数法数（bundle addition 不算持有者，被 pair 行声明的包持有该行的语言）；计数要读到别的共享 pair 的未声明行时，判无包。
- 以前错在哪：只按 pair 自己的前缀找 base，不认 App 共享 pair，也不读 `overrides.package`。结果 pair 自己变成第三个"持有者"让裸读 409，或者把声明给 X 的行算成 App 的。
- 新的拒绝：仅一处窄化——App 的 pair 把某语言覆盖给了 X 时，后装一个只带该语言的包，现在按 #28802 规则判为 App 模板的 addition 被拒（以前被放行）。第一方调用方 0。
- 风险与回滚：门口精确读答案除 `?package=App` 一处外都不变（已在协议层逐例测量）；两处已接受的残余分歧（注册表答无包、精确读服务）记到 #32561；回滚即 revert。
- 需要你做的：无。由 server 座位 5 复审落地，排在 #32497 之后；专题红线读由 #31527 席位做。

Fixes #32408

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — with the bare-name holders sealed, a package whose only members of an email template's name are locales the App ships none of, while the App's pair stores a row of that locale declaring another package of the App (`overrides.package`), is refused naming the App as an addition to the App's template, where it was admitted because the pair's row counted as the App's own member. First-party packages in that position: 0. Every moved answer is in the table below and in the changeset.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs/` describes how a customization pair's row binds in the registry; ADR-0146 D2/D3 and the epic's ruling on #31699 F2 already state the rule this PR makes every reader follow.

## What the card asked, measured (step 1)

Measured on `27abd458a8` (PR #32214's final head), App `A` (`type: app`) with packages `X`, `Y` (`type: module`, each declaring `A`), and a row stored in `A.custom` hydrated into the registry's bare slot:

| Case | `overlaySlotBinding` (BASE) | `bundleMembersHeldBy` X / Y / A / pair (BASE) | `getEnvironmentScopedItem` (BASE) |
|---|---|---|---|
| X, Y hold; row declares X | the pair itself | en-US / en-US / — / fr-FR (the row is X's on no reader) | undefined |
| X, Y hold; no declaration | the pair itself (a third holder) | en-US / en-US / — / fr-FR | undefined |
| X holds; no declaration | the pair itself (a second holder) | en-US / — / — / fr-FR | undefined |
| A, X hold; row declares X | A | en-US / — / **en-US, fr-FR** / — (X's row counted as the App's) | undefined |
| A, X hold; no declaration | A (#28390 ruling A) | en-US / — / en-US, fr-FR / — | undefined |

Both readers bound the row without reading `overrides.package`, and the binding never looked through the App (`isPairOf`): it read the pair's per-package base (`customizationBasePackageId`) only. `getEnvironmentScopedItem` never served a pair's row in any case, before or after: its reach is none.

## The fix

`SchemaRegistry#overlaySlotBinding` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`) asks a new `pairRowBinding` for a row stored in a customization pair when some holder of the name is a package that pair customizes (`isPairOf`, `@objectstack/metadata-core`). It reads the row the way the exact read's one owner check does (`pairRowOnAddress`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`): the declared holder when the pair customizes it, else the App whose own pair it is (#28390 ruling A), else the one owner, else no package. Owners are counted as the exact read counts holders (`packageScopedHoldersOf`), over every holder of the name with every row bound to it (`ownersHoldingAName`): a bundle addition to another holder, of the App or outside it, holds no name (#28802); a package a row of the pair is declared for holds that row's locale, so it is no addition when another holder ships that locale; the undeclared rows of the pair being decided are left out (`settledPairRowBinding` splits them off). When the count would read an undeclared row of another App's shared pair, whose binding waits on that pair's own count, the row binds to no package (epic seat 1's ruling: no guess, no fixed point; the shapes where the exact read answers otherwise belong to #32561). An addition that ships the row's own locale stays an owner, since the row may customize that package's member (contract review F1, F4 and F6, delta rounds). A declared package the pair's holders do not include binds it to no package. A pair no holder is customized by keeps the per-package reading, so every one-holder and legacy per-package-pair case binds as before. The registry imports the pair lookup from `@objectstack/metadata-core` (it already imported `pairsOf` from there); it does not import `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, whose readers stay out of objectql's lean entry.

Because the four readers (`packageScopedHoldersOf`, `bundleMembersHeldBy`, `getPackageScopedItem`, `getEnvironmentScopedItem`) share the one binding, the fix is one place and covers the whole class on this path, `getPackageScopedItem` included (#32214 had patched it alone with `pairRowDeclaresAnotherHolder`, which stays for a pair that customizes none of the holders).

## Moved answers (FROM → TO)

| # | Surface | FROM | TO | Clause-② arm | Pinned in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bare-name gate (`registerItem` / install, holders sealed): a package with only a locale the App does not ship, while the App's pair overrides that locale for X | admitted (the pair's row counted as the App's member, so no addition) | refused `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` naming the App (#28802 addition rule) | narrowing | objectql `package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`, `NARROWING — a later package whose only locale…` |
| 2 | `packageScopedHoldersOf`: the App holds no item of the name | the pair counted as a holder of its own | never a holder | — (feeds 3–4) | same file, `bound to X → only X`, `unbound with two…`, `unbound with one…` |
| 3 | Bare read (`GET /meta/TYPE/NAME`, `resolvePackageScopedName`), one package of the App holds the name | `409 ambiguous-in-environment` naming X and the pair | corrects a false 409 (pair counted as a holder): the row (X's customization), or X's own item when the row declares a non-holder. The holder count reads the exact read's rule (`isPairOf`, as `pairRowOnAddress`); two real holders still refuse | widening (epic seat 1: compliant) | `unbound with one package…`; `CONTROL — two real holders…`; protocol measurement below |
| 4 | Bare read and `?package=A` refusals, two packages of the App hold the name | `409` naming X, Y and the pair | `409` naming X and Y | — (candidate list) | `unbound with two packages…` |
| 5 | `getPackageScopedItem(X)`: row declares X, or X is the one owner | X's own shipped item (none for an added locale) | the row — what `?package=X` already served (one accepted exception: the residual below, #32561) | — (registry agrees with the exact read outside #32561) | `bound to X → only X`, `bound to X beside the App…`, `bound to X, a bundle member…`, `unbound with one…` |
| 6 | `getPackageScopedItem(A.custom)` | the row | none (the pair is no holder; `?package=A.custom` still serves the row) | — | `unbound with two…` |
| 7 | A holder's bundle members (`bundleMembersHeldBy`): row declares X | counted as the App's (or the pair's) | counted as X's | — (feeds 1) | `bound to X, a bundle member…` |
| 8 | `?package=A`, row declares a package that holds no item of the name | the row (the exact read judged it no member of A and fell back to A's registry item, which was the row again) | A's own item | — (semantic) | `a row declaring a package that holds no item…` |
| 9 | `getEnvironmentScopedItem` | undefined | undefined | — (unchanged, measured) | every case asserts it |

Unchanged, measured on the protocol (`getMetaItem`) for the same cases: `?package=X`, `?package=Y`, `?package=A.custom`, and `?package=A` outside row 8, serve or refuse as before; the App's own address keeps an undeclared row of its pair (`CONTROL — the App's own address keeps #28390 ruling A`).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-resolver.test.ts` (the shared harness): one new describe, 11 cases — the card's three pins (bound to X → only X, with and without the App holding, and as a bundle member; unbound with two → neither; unbound with one → that one), the narrowing, the declared non-holder, the ruling-A control, the epic seat's control (two independent holders still refuse the bare read, with or without a pair row beside them), contract review F1's pair (an undeclared row beside a bundle addition of another package of the App binds to the one package holding the name; a CONTROL where the addition ships the row's own locale binds to no package), and contract review F4's two (b: a pair row declaring the addition's package for a locale another holder ships makes it a holder, so an undeclared row beside it binds to no package; a: an addition to a holder outside the App is no owner, so the row binds to X), and contract review F6's CONTROL (two Apps' pairs each storing an undeclared row of the name: neither row binds) — 14 cases. `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (its #31699 F2 describe): the F1 case read through `?package=X`, served there and bound to X by the registry alike; the F4 (b) case, refused at `?package=X` naming X and the addition, and bound to no package by the registry alike.
- **F4 (b) is reachable, measured at the save door** (the real protocol over the real engine, a scratch probe, not committed): a pair row declaring Y for a locale Y does not ship is refused (`declared_package_ships_no_such_item`), and so are the legacy `Y.custom` spellings (undeclared: X ships it; declared Y: Y ships none; declared X: only `A.custom` may). But while Y v1 ships `en-US` the declared `A.custom` row is admitted, and it outlives Y v2 dropping `en-US` (the row stays stored and served). So the shape exists after an upgrade, and the count is fixed rather than declared unreachable. The F6 shape is admitted directly (both undeclared rows saved through the door, measured the same way).
- **Ablation, once per round** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each restored by the tool, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - Final head `075fb318`, the binding put back to the per-package reading (`const paired = NOT_A_PAIR_ROW_OF_A_HOLDER; // ABLATED #32408`): **12 failed / 207 passed** of 219 — every binding pin red; the controls (ruling A, two independent Apps, the F1 CONTROL, the F6 CONTROL) stay green.
  - F1 (`ownersHoldingAName` call replaced by `owners`), at `d9d3621f`: the 2 F1 pins red, 213 green.
  - F4 (the count put back to the owners and their own-stamped rows), at `a8b63c29`: the 3 F4 pins red, 215 green.
  - F6 (`return owners` for another pair's undeclared row replaced by `continue`), at `075fb318`: the F6 CONTROL red, 218 green.
- Round 1: at head `c76886282` the anchor `const paired = this.pairRowBinding(stamped, item, composite);` replaced by `const paired = NOT_A_PAIR_ROW_OF_A_HOLDER; // ABLATED #32408` (the per-package reading put back). Red: **7 failed / 69 passed** of the harness's 76 — every new case except the two controls (ruling A, and two independent holders), which stay green as controls must. Restored by the tool: blob equal to HEAD (`975c8f84f0cf`), `git diff HEAD` empty. The BASE readings in the case names were each read under the same ablation (bare read `409` naming X and the pair; the gate admitting the addition; the App's address serving the row).
- Protocol measurement (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation#getMetaItem` over the real registry, bare and `?package=` of A, X, Y and the pair, 9 cases) before and after: the moves are rows 3, 4 and 8; nothing else moved. Kept as a probe, not committed (the pins above hold the registry half, and the exact read's own pins in `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` are unchanged and green).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's surface guess (`packages/metadata`) was wrong: both readers are in objectql's `SchemaRegistry`.
- `overrides.package` naming a package the save gate would not accept (a non-holder, or one the pair does not customize) is off-door data (the save gate writes the declaration only where the base ships the item); such a row now binds to no package instead of to the App or the pair.
- **Residual divergence, accepted by the seat and the epic seat (red-line read 6814925975: the registry is the side that does not guess). Follow-up: #32561** (the exact read adopts the registry's count). Two shapes:
  - (1) An undeclared pair row of the very locale a bundle addition of another package of the App ships. an undeclared pair row of the very locale a bundle addition of another package of the App ships. The registry binds it to no package (it may customize the addition's member: two owners). The exact read counts holders after that binding, so the addition holds no name there and `?package=X` serves the row (measured). Binding it to X instead would make X hold that locale, the addition stop being one, and the exact read then refuse at X: the two counts have no common answer here without changing the exact read's holder count. Pinned as a CONTROL on the registry side.
  - (2) Contract review F6, per epic seat 1's ruling: a pair's undeclared row while another App's shared pair stores an undeclared row of the name. The registry binds it to no package; the exact read serves or refuses it by its own count. Measured on the pinned CONTROL (App B: P `en-US`, Q on P `de-DE`, `B.custom` row `fr-FR`; App A: U on A and P `fr-FR`, Y `it-IT`, `A.custom` row `es-ES`; both rows admitted at the save door): the registry binds neither row, while `?package=Y` serves the `es-ES` row and `?package=P` serves the `fr-FR` row.
  - The changeset states both, and its title no longer claims the registry answers what the exact read serves in every case.
- Contract review F4 (a), an owner that is an addition to a holder outside the App: the exact read serves the undeclared row at `?package=X`, and the registry bound it to no package (the refusing side). The F4 count aligns it (the registry now binds it to X); against `main` this is row 5's move, so no new table row. Pinned.
